findings.title: Invalidate pre-load shortcut filters before suppressing same-bucket refreshes
findings.description: An updateSites operation started before requestView resolves can capture empty allSites and await a shortcut digest. load installs the newly received sites without changing siteRevision. The older filter remains current by siteRevision and later replaces the valid view with its obsolete empty result. The new resizeLimit guard suppresses same-bucket resize events that previously repaired the list. The new limit check in load only checks width changes during its own filter.
reproduction: Persist one custom shortcut and hide it. Begin initial request at width 1000.
Before background response, resize to 900; let updateSites filter hidden custom shortcut against empty allSites and hold its digest promise.
Resolve background response with eight visible top sites. Initial load paints five shortcuts.
Complete the older digest. The stale filter paints zero shortcuts.
Resize to 899. Baseline recovers to five; current candidate stays at zero.
findings.attribution: Stale overwrite is inherited; persistent failure to recover on same-bucket resize is introduced by the guard. This is an offline controlled asynchronous schedule, not a real-browser incident.
findings.probeScope: Actual startNewTab and ShortcutPreferences.load/filter. Fake storage/request, controlled WebCrypto promise completion, rendering and unrelated UI installers stubbed. Baseline loaded from git HEAD.
findings.recommendedFix: Share freshness handling between load and updateSites so new allSites invalidates earlier filters and only a current result reaches view. Cover this pre-response filter ordering while retaining same-bucket no-work after a valid result.

reviewConclusions.translation: Fresh diff is one condition reorder against captured baseline. Unchanged translated records skip allowed. New/site-edited nodes and every in-flight write retain eligibility checks. Per-batch pruning and Restore/detach/reattach timing remain unchanged; baseline differential tests pass.
reviewConclusions.toast: Running onclick closure retains action after hideToast clears property. Expiry releases callback; active click still invokes captured Undo once. Test passes.
reviewConclusions.newtab: Existing tests cover bucket crossings, same-width no work, storage changes, explicit Reset, failed resize retry and delayed initial filter. They miss the pre-response stale filter reproduced here.
reviewConclusions.migration: Exact nine-resource set. Replacement hashes, source before/after hashes and plan after pins all checked before backup/source writes. Idempotent after files are not rewritten. Other plan pins and compiled fixture preserved. Interrupt-before-pin cases pass. Changed source content necessarily changes its mtime; repeat-migration mtimes preserved.
reviewConclusions.packaging: Exact eleven current host module names, protocol after consistency, packet/installed checksum, installed containment and no leaf symlink, plus Breezer identity checked. Archive checksum/member size/type/allowlist retained. Native matching-host runtime version/architecture checks retained. Caller still signs/verifies runtime and app after packaging. No live signature/trust/architecture acceptance claimed.
